title: WEAK POINTS ARE SOCKETS
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of every character and machine, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. A weak point was drawn as a bright coloured disc with a big glow round it, so the brightest thing on a Sentry, a Warden or a Pillbox was its weak point, brighter than its eye, and at play size a Warden read as two coloured wheels. The eye is the face of a machine and should win. Each weak point is now a recessed socket: a dark ring with a thin ring in its own colour (orange for a vent, blue for an optic, as before) and a small core, held well below the eye and gently pulsing, so you can still find it. When it is hot, after a hit has overheated it, it glows at full strength so the moment to punish is unmistakable. Where the weak points are, how they turn with the machine and what a hit on one does are all unchanged.
now: Machine weak points are drawn as dark sockets below the eye, and glow full only when overheated.

edits.replacement: sprWeakPts(e2);   // v23.xx (spr6): the openings are recessed sockets held below the eye, glowing full only when hot
